title: Listing Optimization
seo: eBay listing optimization for live listings
meta: Improve titles, categories, item specifics and photos on your live eBay listings so they are easier to find. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: eBay listing optimization, from titles to photos
overview: We go through your live eBay listings and find what is holding them back: weak titles, wrong categories, missing item specifics, poor photos and unclear condition. We fix the clearest problems first, record each change in a sheet and leave your best sellers alone unless there is a real gain. Results depend on demand, price and competition, so we say what we changed and why rather than promise rankings.

list: Up to 20 photos cropped and cleaned

faq: Will editing live listings reset my sales history?
We make normal edits to titles, specifics and photos, which keep the listing's sales history. If a change would need a brand new listing, we tell you first and let you decide.
Not in this service. We suggest price checks where they matter, but pricing changes are part of pricing and offers, and always your decision.
No, and we do not do it. eBay discourages misleading or stuffed titles. We use the 80 characters for brand, type, size, color and condition words that buyers really use.
Can you fix listings that eBay flagged?
If a listing has a policy notice, we read it, correct the cause and prepare a short note for you to send. We cannot promise eBay will reinstate it, because that is eBay's decision.
